title: 第五章 前世之身为白银盟主淫帝他爹加更第六章 原始山脉
content_zh:
（感谢天下第九的总盟淫帝他爹接连两个百万打赏，成就白银大盟主。加更一章！注：白银盟加更是两章，因为存稿有限，现在先每人加更一章，上架后再继续加更吧。）
狄九将石块用包好，贴身挂起后，这才开始整理飞行器里面的东西。
飞行器无法再启动，狄九找出一个背包，将一些自觉得有用又不占地方的东西塞进包里。
至于飞行器，他只能将其琐死，又在旁边割了一堆荆棘将其遮起。无论将来会不会来拿走这个飞行器，这个飞行器当初都花了他许多的金币，关键的部分还都是他自己设计出来的。
狄九处理完这些，正想要寻找出路，就看见距离他只有数步远的地方侧卧着一个人，看背后应该是一个男子。原本以为这里是人迹罕至的地方，这突然看见一个人，让狄九吓了一跳。
这人的衣着样式很是古怪，至少他没有看见过，在这人的身边不远处也是有一个蓝色大背包。他的手中还抓着一株药材，看起来是一朵花。
小心的走到这人的身边，狄九确信这人应该是死去了。他转到这男子的正面，当他看清楚这男子的长相时，手中的包下意识的落在了地上，嘴里喃喃自语道，“难道我已经死了？”
足足过去数息之后，狄九才醒悟过来，自己肯定没有死。可是这死去的男子和他太像了，不对，不应该说是像，而是长的一摸一样。
狄九弯下腰，他打算小心的将这男子放平。当他的手刚刚触摸到这男子的身体时，胸口的那枚灰色石头似乎热了一下，一种奇异的感觉涌上心头，没有任何理由的在狄九的意识中多了一种感应，这男子就是他的前世。
不但如此，他甚至还能模糊的抓取这男子的一些记忆信息。或者说是因为触碰到这男子，他模糊记忆起了前世的一些东西。
狄九将刚刚用布裹住挂在脖子上的石头又抓了出来，打开放在手心反复的查看。穿过虚空裂缝，居然出现在前世死去的地点，触碰到前世之身，还可以记忆起前世的一些东西，这肯定不是巧合。他怀疑是因为这石头的原因，他才能看见自己的前世之身。
足足过了半柱香时间，狄九才将灰色石头再次贴身放好。短短时间，他经历的事情实在是太多了，九族被夷，见到前世之身，获得灰色石头，穿过莫名其妙的虚空裂缝，来到一个从未听说过的地方……
还有什么比这更悲伤和离谱的？经历了如此多的事情，如今的他再也不是那个对甄蔓还念念不忘的狄九。
长长的吁了口气，狄九将不远处的蓝色大背包打开。
几件换洗的衣服，一些野外旅游的工具和一些干粮、水、地图、指南针。除此之外还有一个皮夹和几本书，以及一个棕色的小本本。
打开皮夹，其中有几张华夏币。以前他从未见过这种纸币，现在一看见依然有了这样的概念。不仅如此，纸币上的字他也全部认识，看样子他的确是找到了自己前世的部分记忆。
除了这几张华夏币之外，皮夹中还有几张卡、一张相片、一把钥匙和交纳过房租的收据。几张卡是银行卡，密码任凭狄九如何都记忆不起来。
还有一张身份证，名字叫狄子默。
相片拿出来，是一张合影。左侧的正是他的前世狄子默，右侧的是一名极其清丽漂亮的女子。这个合影显然是被撕开过，后来用胶布黏起来的。
在狄九看来，这女子的容貌甚至不下于他喜欢过的甄蔓，偏偏他得到的前世记忆中，没有这名女子的记忆。

狄九将相片放入皮夹，看样子他这一世混的还不如前世。前世至少还有一个如此漂亮的女人相伴，而这一世，他出身济国狄家，老爹出面也无法让他得到甄蔓的欢喜。
将皮夹放进自己的口袋，不要说这本来就是他的前世之身，就算不是，这东西他收起来，也没有什么不好意思。
棕色的小本本被狄九打开，随即他就看见了离婚证三个字。
狄九揉了揉自己的头发，无论是前世还是今生，他的女人缘都不咋地。叹息一声，将这些东西全部整理好放进了自己的包中。
清点了东西后狄九又找了一个看起来很不错的地方，挖了一个坑。无论如何，他也要将自己的前世肉身埋葬起来。
将前世之身搬到土坑中的时候，狄九总算是看见了致命伤，一块半尺长的尖锐石头从狄子默的腰间插了进去。不但如此，狄子默的身体骨骼断裂了几十处。狄九看了看前方的峭壁，他估计这应该是从悬崖上滚下来造成的。
自己埋自己，听起来很荒唐，做起来却更是悲凉。
就是在济国，前世之说也只是一种对生命的寄托，而现在真实的发生在他身上。
狄九拿走了一套衣服，其余的衣服和手机甚至那个大包他都送入了坑中，一起埋了起来。
最后狄九将那朵花拿起来，前世他临死都将这朵花抓在手中，这朵花就留在这里好了。
只是当狄九将这花拿起来后，他的脸色立即就变得古怪起来。这朵花他认识，叫红桖花。
在济国红桖花根本就是无价之宝，就是济国王邬霸湖的女儿邬明珠，如果有这样一朵红桖花，她的眼睛就是灵性溃了，也可以用红桖花复原，根本就不用挖他姐姐狄笛的眼睛去换。
握住这一朵红桖花，狄九发了足足呆了数分钟，这才将这朵花也放入了自己的背包。
经历了一族被灭后，狄九再也不会和之前那样天真。他肯定狄氏九族被灭，不是因为他父亲骂了一通邬霸湖。
邬霸湖之所以要挖狄笛的眼睛，除了真爱邬明珠之外，还有就是故意激怒父亲狄衫，然后借口灭掉狄家。
如此说来，他的五个哥哥殁于王事，都有些问题在其中了。很有可能是因为他狄家掌控了济国七成军队，引起了老王八的猜忌，让老王八先布局杀了他五个哥哥。
邬霸湖这老王八，果然是腹黑到了极点。如果自己这一世还有机会回到亚伦大陆，他不将邬家连根都铲除了，他就对不起被邬霸湖灭掉的狄氏全族。
不对，曲小树说邬霸湖这个老王八要杀他父亲，没有一个人求情，这绝对不可能。以他老爹的威望，怎么可能没有人求情？再说就算是他老爹就是骂了邬霸湖那又如何？邬霸湖敢动他老爹？他老爹好歹也是一个大武师强者，更是掌控者济国军队。以他老爹的个性，因为愚忠束手就擒，那绝无可能。
除非……
狄九想到这里打了个冷战，除非有人控制了所有和他父亲交好的人，甚至主动出手制住了他父亲和他父亲身边的人，而且还不惧父亲背后的力量。

邬霸湖有这个本事？有这种这种能力的人只能是武王，可是武王真的有这么厉害？
如果真的是这样，那就代表着他的仇人可不仅仅是邬霸湖，还有比邬霸湖更加厉害的存在。狄九深深的吸了口气，哪怕他的仇人是泸元帝国，只要他能回去，他就不会这样算了。

Note: The Silver Alliance will add two more chapters. Due to the limited manuscripts, each person will add one chapter now, and then continue to add updates after it is released.)
Di Jiu wrapped the stones and hung them up close to his body before starting to sort out the things inside the aircraft.
The aircraft could no longer be started, so Di Jiu found a backpack and stuffed it into the bag with some things that he thought were useful and did not take up space.
As for the aircraft, he could only kill it and cut a pile of thorns next to it to cover it. Regardless of whether he would come and take away this aircraft in the future, this aircraft cost him a lot of gold coins in the first place, and he designed the key parts himself.
After Di Jiu dealt with this, he was about to find a way out when he saw a person lying on his side only a few steps away from him. It looked like it was a man behind him. Originally thinking that this place was an inaccessible place, Di Jiu was startled when he suddenly saw a person.
This man's clothing style was very strange, at least he had never seen it before. There was also a big blue backpack not far from this man's side. He was also holding a medicinal plant in his hand, which looked like a flower.
Walking carefully to this person's side, Di Jiu was sure that this person was probably dead. He turned to the front of the man. When he saw the man's appearance clearly, the bag in his hand fell to the ground subconsciously, and he murmured to himself, "Am I already dead?"
After a few breaths passed, Di Jiu finally realized that he was definitely not dead. But the dead man looked so much like him. No, I shouldn't say he looked like him, but he looked exactly the same.
Di Jiu bent down, intending to carefully lay the man down. When his hand just touched the man's body, the gray stone on his chest seemed to heat up, and a strange feeling came to his heart. For no reason, there was an extra feeling in Di Jiu's consciousness that this man was his previous life.
Not only that, he could even vaguely capture some of the man's memory information. Or maybe it was because of touching this man that he vaguely remembered something from his previous life.
Di Jiu took out the stone that had just been wrapped in cloth and hung around his neck, opened it, put it in the palm of his hand, and looked at it repeatedly. After passing through the cracks in the void, he actually appeared at the place where he died in his previous life, touched his body in his previous life, and could still remember some things from his previous life. This was definitely not a coincidence. He suspected that it was because of this stone that he could see his past life.
After half a stick of incense, Di Jiu placed the gray stone close to his body again. In a short period of time, he experienced too many things. Nine tribes were wiped out, he saw his past life, obtained a gray stone, passed through an inexplicable crack in the void, and came to a place he had never heard of...
What could be more sad and outrageous than this? After experiencing so many things, he is no longer the Di Jiu who still misses Zhen Man.
With a long sigh, Di Jiu opened the large blue backpack not far away.
A few changes of clothes, some tools for wilderness travel, some dry food, water, maps, and compasses. In addition there was a wallet and several books, as well as a small brown notebook.
Opening the wallet, there were several Chinese coins in it. He had never seen this kind of banknote before, but now he still had this concept when he saw it. Not only that, he also knew all the words on the banknotes. It seemed that he had indeed found part of his past life memory.
In addition to these Chinese coins, there are several cards, a photo, a key and receipts for paying rent in the wallet. Several of the cards were bank cards, and Di Jiu couldn't remember the passwords no matter what.
There is also an ID card named Di Zimo.
The photo was taken out and it was a group photo. The one on the left is his previous life Di Zimo, and the one on the right is an extremely beautiful woman. This group photo was obviously torn apartYes, it was later glued together with tape.
In Di Jiu's opinion, this woman's appearance was no less than that of Zhen Man, whom he had fallen in love with before. However, there was no memory of this woman in the past life memories he had obtained.
Di Jiu put the photo in his wallet. It seemed that he was worse off in this life than in his previous life. In his previous life, he was accompanied by at least one such beautiful woman, but in this life, he was born in the Di family of Ji State, and his father could not make him win Zhen Man's favor.
Putting the wallet into his pocket, don't say that it was his previous life. Even if it wasn't, he put it away without any embarrassment.
The small brown notebook was opened by Di Jiu, and then he saw the words "divorce certificate".
Di Jiu rubbed his hair. No matter in his previous life or in this life, his popularity with women was not good. With a sigh, he organized all these things and put them into his bag.
After counting the things, Di Jiu found a place that looked good and dug a hole. No matter what, he had to bury his previous body.
When he moved his previous body into the pit, Di Jiu finally saw the fatal injury. A sharp stone half a foot long was inserted into Di Zimo's waist. Not only that, Di Zimo's body bones were broken in dozens of places. Di Jiu looked at the cliff in front of him. He estimated that this was caused by rolling down the cliff.
Burying oneself sounds ridiculous, but it is even more tragic to do it.
Even in Jiguo, the theory of past lives was just a kind of sustenance for life, but now it really happened to him.
Di Jiu took away a set of clothes. He sent the rest of the clothes, the mobile phone and even the big bag into the pit and buried them together.
Finally, Di Jiu picked up the flower. In his previous life, he held the flower in his hand before he died, so he just left it here.
But when Di Jiu picked up the flower, his expression immediately became strange. He knew this flower, it was called the red aloe flower.
In the state of Ji, the red aloe flower is a priceless treasure. It is Wu Mingzhu, the daughter of King Wu Bahu of Ji. If there is such a red aloe flower, her eyes will be damaged spiritually, and they can be restored with the red aloe flower. There is no need to dig out the eyes of his sister Didi to replace them.
Holding the red alfalfa flower, Di Jiufa stayed there for several minutes before putting the flower into his backpack.
After experiencing the annihilation of his clan, Di Jiu will never be as naive as before. He was sure that the nine Di clans were destroyed not because his father cursed Wu Bahu.
The reason why Wu Bahu wanted to gouge Di Di's eyes was not only his true love for Wu Mingzhu, but also because he deliberately angered his father Di Shan and then used it as an excuse to destroy the Di family.
In this way, his five brothers died in the king's affairs, and there were some problems involved. It was most likely because the Di family controlled 70% of the Jiguo army, which aroused the suspicion of the old bastard, and asked the old bastard to kill his five brothers first.
The old bastard Wu Bahu is indeed extremely sinister. If he still has a chance to return to the Allen Continent in this life, if he doesn't eradicate the Wu family from the roots, he will be sorry for the entire Di family that was wiped out by Wu Ba Lake.
No, Qu Xiaoshu said that this old bastard Wu Bahu wanted to kill his father, and no one asked for mercy. This is absolutely impossible. With his father's prestige, how could no one ask for mercy? Besides, even if his father just scolded Wu Bahu, so what? Wu Bahu dared to touch his father? After all, his father was also a powerful martial artist, and he controlled the Jiguo army. With his father's personality, it would be absolutely impossible for him to be captured because of Yu Zhong.
Unless...
Di Jiu shuddered at the thought of this, unless someone controlled all the people who were friends with his father, and even took the initiative to control his father and the people around his father, and he was not afraid of the power behind his father.
Does Wu Bahu have this ability? A person with this kind of ability can only be King Wu, but is King Wu really that powerful?
If this is really the case, it means that heHis enemy is not only Wu Bahu, but also someone even more powerful than Wu Bahu. Di Jiu took a deep breath. Even if his enemy was the Luyuan Empire, as long as he could go back, he would not let it go.
